cohort: 53,571 deliveries at a metropolitan hospital in Santiago
finding: The overall C-section rate increased from 24% to 27% over the 9-year study period, with the greatest increase observed in Robson's groups 1, 3, and 4.
mod_finding: While cesarean section rates increased across multiple Robson classification groups, the group with one or more previous C-sections had the strongest impact on the overall C-section rate.
